sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Manufacture of Urban Electric Cargo Bicycles and Step-Through Scooters

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: PACER Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Act No. 33 of 2018 (as amended); International Companies Act [Cap. 222]; Financial Dealers Act [Cap. 232]; VFSC AML/CFT Rules and associated supervisory directives.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport (identification and national address)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport Registry / Notary Public in country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Vanuatu is not a party to the Hague Apostille Convention)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or local financial institution
Applicant's hosting bank or correspondent bank

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Professional reference / CV of director and UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public or current professional engagement

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Corporate documents of any corporate UBO (Certificate of Incorporation and Register of Directors)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry of the respective jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if issuing registry is a Hague member state; otherwise Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Irrevocable Power of Attorney for incorporation and registered agent instructions

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs and controllers against the Vanuatu consolidated UN sanctions list, OFAC SDN list, EU list, UK HMT list, and domestic CFT directives; PEP status of every UBO/director is identified through a Notified Jurisdiction Person (NJP) questionnaire and a risk-rating matrix; enhanced due diligence is triggered for any match or heightened-risk jurisdiction.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) e-Registry / Company Search portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: English is the statutory language for company names; a proposed name must be rendered in Latin characters, with a transliteration or translated script if required by the registered agent; the name must not be identical or deceptively similar to any existing/registered name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within 14 working days of rejection the applicant's registered agent may file a written Notice of Appeal with the VFSC Registrar, attaching the name search report and evidence that misleading similarity or prohibited token does not apply; the Registrar issues a final determination within 15 working days; if still refused, renewal of the reservation can be applied for with an adjusted name.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for a Vanuatu International Company provided that a licensed registered agent in Vanuatu maintains the registered office address; because the business model is offshore OEM contract manufacturing, no in-country physical trading office is required, and the registered agent's address may serve as the statutory office.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low: estimated annual probability of unannounced physical inspection of the registered agent's office is <5% for an offshore IC with no Vanuatu-based physical presence; however, if the IC maintains actual inventory or manufacturing operations in Vanuatu, an on-site inspection becomes likely (>50%).

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the International Companies Act and VFSC Fee Schedule
Statutory tariff under the International Companies Act and VFSC Fee Schedule
Prevailing market benchmark for low-risk IC holding companies

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certificate of Incorporation and incumbency issuance bundle
UBO log and AML/KYC compliance pack preparation
Legalization and notarization disbursements (consular fees and courier)
Professional advisory and structuring fee (stage 1 only)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for offshore IC formation

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [CAP 222] of Vanuatu, particularly sections 4 (incorporation), 7 (Articles), 9 (registered office and agent), 13 (directors), 16 (secretary), and 19 (tax exemption). Supplemental Companies Act [CAP 191] applies to matters not covered by the IC Act.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – International Companies and Trusts Registry, Port Vila, Vanuatu
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form IC-1 'Application for Incorporation of an International Company' together with the Memorandum and Articles of Association and consent of the licensed registered agent
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no escrow/deposit requirement for an International Company. Shares may be issued for such consideration, whether in cash or otherwise, as the directors determine, and shares may be issued in any unrestricted currency.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the subscribers approve the issue and allotment of ordinary shares to the initial subscriber for the consideration stated in the Articles; that the registered office of the Company be established at the address filed with the Vanuatu International Companies Registry; and that the first directors and officers be appointed as submitted to the Registry, with authority to open bank accounts, appoint service agents, and execute commercial licenses. FURTHER RESOLVED that all registration fees, annual fees, agent fees, and incidental expenses be paid, indemnities be granted to the formation agent, and that the Company adopt the submitted Articles of Association together with any requisite bylaws.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Instruction and KYC Submission to Licensed Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Deliver company name, principal place of business abroad, subscriber particulars, passport copies, beneficial ownership declarations, and intended capital structure to the licensed agent. The agent drafts the Memorandum and Articles of Association and submits the name pre-clearance to the Registry, if the name is to be reserved.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of passport of each subscriber
Residential address proof (utility bill or bank reference)
Corporate profile and intended business summary
Bank and professional AML reference for the ultimate beneficial owner
Certificate of Incorporation of any corporate shareholder (if any)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry requests clarification or KYC completeness, the agent submits additional documentation within 5 business days; all resubmission costs are borne by the applicant.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Application to VFSC International Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission – International Companies and Trusts Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the completed Form IC-1, executed Memorandum and Articles, consent to act as registered agent, consent to act as registered office provider, and declaration of compliance with the International Companies Act. Pay the prescribed government filing fee by wire transfer or card through the authorized payment gateway.
required_dossiers: Form IC-1 signed by the subscriber or agent
Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consent of licensed registered agent
Consent of registered office provider
Declaration of non-resident/offshore activity and tax exempt status
Power of attorney from subscribers to the agent (if notarized)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: The Registry issues a 7-day correction query; the agent resubmits revised documents, and the certificate is issued within 3 days after the correct filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Statutory Register Creation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies and Trusts Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon acceptance of the application, the Registry endorses the submission, allocates an International Company registration number, and issues the Certificate of Incorporation with a dated corporate seal. The registered agent then creates the company statutory registers: shareholders, directors, officers, registered charges, and registered office.
required_dossiers: VFSC stamped application
Payment receipt of government filing fee
Certificate of good standing of the registered agent (if requested)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains a typographical or naming error, the agent files a formal correction request and the Registry re-issues within 2 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Organizational Meeting and First Board Resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: First directors and initial subscribers of the International Company
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene a virtual or written-procedure meeting of the first directors to approve the issue of shares, adopt the board resolution quoted above, appoint officers, adopt a corporate seal, establish the authorized signatories, and approve the bank account documentation package.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consents to act as director/officer
Minutes or written resolution of the first board meeting
Specimen share certificate and share register
Registered agent certificate of good standing
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any director or officer consent is defective or a director is not a natural person as required, the board re-commissions consents and repeats the resolution within 2 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Business License, Industrial Registration, and Corporate Bank Account Onboarding
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Industry (Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Commerce) and the chosen VFSC-licensed banking institution
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit to the Department of Industry the Certificate of Incorporation, board resolution authorizing the physical manufacturing site, site lease or deed, and proposed industrial activities. File for a Business Licence under the Business Licence Act [CAP 228] at the relevant municipal authority. Concurrently open a non-resident corporate bank account for the IC; for e-bike export revenue, request telegraphic transfer and SWIFT LC lines.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation and certified Articles
Form 10 (Director/Officer Particulars and Registered Office Confirmation) from the Registry
Board resolution authorizing manufacturing site and signatories
Site lease or land registration certificate
Manufacturing plant floor plan and equipment list
Preliminary Environmental Registration or EIA screening application
Clean corporate record/VFSC certificate of good standing
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipal license application is objected to, the applicant may amend the site operating description and file an appeal with the Municipal Council within 14 days; with Council approval, the license is reissued within 3 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Department of Industry, Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Commerce, Government of Vanuatu; municipal licensing authority in Port Vila or Luganville
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Manufacturing Business Licence under the Business Licence Act [CAP 228] and Foreign Investment/Industrial Registration, if the manufacturing activity is conducted from Vanuatu soil

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Environment, Energy and Disaster Management
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Screening Tier (Category A) for electric bicycle assembly operations with no battery manufacturing; a Full EIA Report is required if operations include battery casing chemical treatment, paint spraying, metal plating, or any discharge of effluent above 5 m³ per day.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Effluent must comply with Vanuatu Environment (Waste Management and Pollution Control) Regulations 2015: pH 6.0–9.0; biochemical oxygen demand ≤25 mg/L; total suspended solids ≤35 mg/L; oil and grease ≤10 mg/L. VOC emissions from paint booths must be captured by dry-filter/carbon systems and kept below 20 g/m³ outlet concentration. Waste electrical and electronic equipment and used lithium batteries must be segregated and exported under the Basel Convention prior authorization.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Vanuatu Fire Service after inspection of the manufacturing floor, fire exits, extinguisher placement, and lithium battery storage separation; Structural Load Inspection Certificate from the Public Works Department for mezzanine storage, racking, and material lifts; and an Occupational Workplace Health and Safety Clearance from the Department of Labour for machine guarding, employee safety training, and first-aid preparedness.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Government of Vanuatu; taxpayer portal: VRC online services and e-filing portal accessible through the official MFEM/Vanuatu Government portal at gov.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: An International Company (IC) that carries on no Vanuatu taxable activity is automatically outside the income tax and VAT net and is not required to obtain a TIN; company identification is the VFSC-registered IC number. If the IC begins or intends to carry on a taxable activity with actual/expected turnover of at least VUV 5,000,000 in any 12-month period, it must file the VAT registration application with VRC, attaching the certificate of incorporation, memorandum and articles, register of directors/shareholders, identification of beneficial owners, proof of business address, and a brief description of the activity. VRC issues the VAT registration number (VRN) and certificate. Customs will assign a separate importer/customs reference for physical imports even in the absence of a TIN.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election exists in Vanuatu; the IC's exemption from income tax is mandatory and non-waivable. An IC can voluntarily register for VAT under the VAT Act if it carries on taxable supplies below the compulsory threshold. Vanuatu has no hybrid mismatch or entity classification elections because there is no corporate income tax; the VAT registration election does not alter the IC's tax-exempt status.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act [No. 41 of 2013], administered by Vanuatu Revenue and Customs; imports into Vanuatu are subject to VAT at the border.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 5,000,000 (Vanuatu vatu) of taxable turnover in any 12 consecutive months (mandatory); voluntary registration is available for taxable supply businesses below the threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time e-invoicing, fiscal clearance, API clearance, or digital stamping mandate currently applies in Vanuatu. Registered businesses must issue valid VAT invoices in paper or digital PDF form containing prescribed particulars (VRN, date, supplier/customer names and addresses, description, quantity, VAT-exclusive price, VAT amount and total) and retain them for VAT return and audit purposes.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods physically exported from Vanuatu in the course of a commercial sale to a non-resident qualify for 0% VAT where the supplier is VAT-registered and obtains and keeps evidence of physical export. Services are zero-rated if supplied to a non-resident and consumed wholly outside Vanuatu. For the electric cargo e-bike manufacturing scope, component exports and finished e-bike sales to offshore distributors or buyers qualify for zero-rating when shipment is made from Vanuatu under normal commercial terms and the goods are delivered to the foreign destination.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (lodged electronically with Vanuatu Customs at the port of export)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing shipment from Vanuatu to a foreign destination
Commercial invoice containing contract terms, Incoterms, and a zero-rated export endorsement
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank credit advice evidencing collection of the export proceeds
Customs-stamped export documentation/outward landing card used by Vanuatu Customs
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs may verify the goods left Vanuatu and that title and payment passed offshore. If zero-rating is claimed without genuine export, the VAT shortfall becomes immediately assessable at 12.5% together with statutory interest. Additional penalties are imposed for incomplete or false returns, including a civil penalty of up to the tax shortfall and criminal prosecution for tax evasion, which can extend to imprisonment. Erroneous export refunds are clawed back by amended assessment, interest, penalties, and set-off against any future refunds.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), which administers the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 66] and the Financial Dealers Licensing Act; the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) exercises supplementary AML/CFT supervision over licensed banks and registers International Companies under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222].
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Legal tender is the Vanuatu Vatu (VUV), managed by the RBV against a Special Drawing Right (SDR) peg. Current-account transactions are fully convertible with no quantitative limits; the capital account is substantially liberalized for International Companies, which are statutorily free to hold and deal in any foreign currency and maintain offshore bank accounts absent restrictive Articles. Profit remittance to non-resident shareholders faces no statutory hurdles: the IC is exempt from income tax, capital gains tax, and withholding tax under the International Companies Act, and no RBV approval or dividend-blocking mechanism applies. The practical convertibility constraint is correspondent-bank due diligence, not domestic regulation; settlement in USD or AUD is standard.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Nil. Vanuatu does not impose any statutory timeline for surrender of export proceeds, any mandatory conversion ratio into VUV, or any RBV-directed repatriation of foreign-currency earnings. A Vanuatu IC exporting electric cargo e-bikes may retain 100% of export receipts in designated multi-currency accounts and redeploy those funds freely for component imports and supplier settlement.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: USD Multi-Currency Operational Account / Swift TT Receiving Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (BSP) Vanuatu Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account / Trade Finance Account (Commercial LC issuance and MT103 disbursement)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility for primary treasury use. Vanuatu has no statutory Electronic Money Institution (EMI) licensing category; VFSC does not issue EMI charters and no digital-bank passporting regime applies. Offshore EMIs (UK, EU, Lithuania, Australia) may provide on-ramp collection and fee aggregation, but they cannot issue VUV-denominated accounts, originate Commercial Letters of Credit, or act as a settlement bank for the IC's Asian OEM supply chain. They may be used as a secondary collection rail for small-value B2B payments, provided that the IC maintains its principal USD liquidity and trade settlement rails with a licensed Vanuatu commercial bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote account opening is generally permitted for a Low_Risk_Standard manufacturing entity, but each bank requires a live video KYC interview with at least one director and the ultimate beneficial owner; physical appearance at a Port Vila branch is not strictly mandatory. The corporate pack must be notarized and apostilled, and a VFSC-registered registered agent must certify the directors and shareholders on the account mandate. If any director, shareholder, or counterparty is connected to a FATF-monitored jurisdiction, banks may escalate to a face-to-face requirement or decline onboarding.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Vanuatu's appearance on the FATF enhanced-monitoring (grey) list triggers enhanced due diligence and possible flat refusals by some correspondent banks
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Active-operating evidence: VFSC International Company registry extract; 3-year financial projections or audited management accounts; board resolution setting out the treasury mandate; certified purchase orders and OEM supply contracts evidencing real e-bike manufacturing; written compliance narrative confirming tax-exempt IC status and trade flow.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial-ownership opacity opening balance; historical bearer-share or nominee structures create a shell-company red flag
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed declaration of UBO; current shareholder register and share-transfer ledger filed with VFSC; certificate of good standing; notarized trust deed if any nominee is deployed, with full disclosure of the underlying principal; evidence that no bearer instruments remain outstanding.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source-of-funds challenge on the inbound equity injection
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Six months of bank statements from the remitting shareholder's regulated bank; introducer's bank reference letter; source-of-wealth statement from the shareholder; board resolution authorizing the capital subscription; VFSC-updated share register evidencing the issuance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Lack of physical substance in Vanuatu raises shell-risk even for qualifying ICs
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed registered-agent agreement; proof of address from the corporate services provider; evidence of the foreign OEM facility (factory lease, equipment inventory, payroll records); commitment to monthly transaction reporting and complete audit trail on demand.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Correspondent-bank de-risking pressure where remittance narratives are ambiguous
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Transaction flow diagram from end-buyer, through the Vanuatu account, to the Asian supplier; USD-denominated invoices and LC terms; annual self-assessment showing no sanctions nexus and no VUV conversion exposure on the core trade route.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Shareholder equity is transmitted by SWIFT MT103 (T/T) in USD directly to the IC's USD-denominated account at ANZ Vanuatu or BSP Vanuatu. The remittance narrative must state 'Equity capital contribution / share subscription' without ambiguous terms; the remitting bank will map the payment to its own balance-of-payments equity code. The receiving bank verifies the credit against a board resolution, the updated VFSC share register, and directors' funds-confirmation letter. No RBV exchange-control approval is required, although the receiving bank will record the credit for statistical purposes and may ask for the underlying board resolution. A segregated Capital Escrow sub-account is recommended until the share issuance is perfected.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary rail is SWIFT MT103 (telegraphic transfer) for prepayments and component purchases, with 20–30% deposit and 70–80% against bill-of-lading copies. Secondary rail is a Commercial Letter of Credit (sight or usance 30–90 days) issued in USD by BSP Vanuatu or ANZ Vanuatu in favor of the Chinese or Southeast Asian OEM supplier, advised via SWIFT MT700 with reimbursement by MT202 cover. Clearing is executed in USD to avoid VUV conversion spreads; VUV is reserved exclusively for local statutory fees and registered-agent costs. Intra-Asia payments use a nominated paying bank under the LC, ensuring documentary compliance on a clean, low-risk trade route.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright forward contracts (USD/AUD, USD/EUR, USD/NZD) with ANZ Vanuatu or BSP Vanuatu, documented against confirmed export purchase orders and import invoices
Short-tenor foreign-exchange swaps with a licensed Vanuatu bank for temporary USD/VUV liquidity bridging during statutory fee and payroll payments

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on VUV with offshore counterparties, permissible as the IC holds no regulated local-currency exposure; market liquidity for VUV NDFs is thin and requires bilateral ISDA or CSA documentation

Natural hedge via dual-currency account structure (USD operational account for trade and a small VUV fee account for local charges), effectively eliminating the need for standalone derivatives on the core cargo-e-bike export/import cycle

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Renewal Fee (VFSC International Company Annual Fee)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) via the licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Payable on or before the last day of the month of incorporation anniversary; e.g. incorporation on 10 March triggers renewal by 31 March each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment penalty of 10% of the annual fee per month or part thereof; continued non-payment for 3 months after the due month may result in administrative strike-off from the International Companies Register

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return and Statutory Declaration Filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Not applicable under the International Companies Act (Cap 222)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No statutory annual return, exemption declaration, or financial statement filing is required for a Vanuatu International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: None; the absence of this filing is non-penalized, but loss of licensed registered agent or failure to maintain the registered office triggers administrative strike-off by VFSC

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent Annual Compliance Confirmation (Registered Office and Register Attestation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) through the licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Concurrent with the annual renewal fee payment; due by the last day of the incorporation month each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure of the registered agent to file confirmation may result in agent penalties under the FSC (Licensing) Act and administrative strike-off of the company

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None; Vanuatu International Companies are statutorily exempt from independent audit and from filing audited financial statements. An audit is required only if mandated by the company's articles of association or by an external financing or partner counterparty.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) are not statutorily imposed; books and records must be kept under Section 47 of the International Companies Act (Cap 222) sufficient to reflect transactions, and may be maintained under any reasonable accounting framework at the registered agent's office; no financial statements are filed with VFSC.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vanuatu International Company law imposes no public UBO registry and no annual beneficial ownership confirmation filing. Share transfers are effected by instrument of transfer, require consent per the articles, and must be notified to the registered agent to update the private Register of Members; UBO/KYC information is collected by the licensed registered agent strictly for AML compliance and remains exempt from public disclosure.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not required by statute; optional certified audit for counterparty assurance US$1,500 - US$3,500

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Absolute zero-rate regime: no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, no tax on dividends, interest, or royalties, no payroll tax for most non-resident business activity, no stamp duty on share transfers, and no estate or inheritance tax. Approved manufacturing projects may additionally obtain Investment Promotion Act exemption certificates waiving import duty on capital equipment and raw materials for e-bike assembly. The only recurring sovereign cost is the fixed VFSC International Company annual license fee (c. USD 150, approx. VUV 17,500).

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC Annual Return under Section 97, International Companies Act 1992 (Cap. 222) — filed through the VFSC Online Registration and Information System or via the licensed Vanuatu registered agent. No corporate income tax return exists because Vanuatu levies no CIT on International Companies or domestic companies.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual — once in each calendar year, within 28 days after the anniversary of incorporation.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 28 days after each anniversary of the date of incorporation; the annual license renewal and the annual return are due simultaneously, and VFSC publishes an annual renewal window ending 30 June for entities whose anniversaries occurred earlier in the calendar year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 — Company Name and VFSC Registration Number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full registered name of the International Company and its unique VFSC company number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact registered name and VFSC number for VU_IC; beneficial owner names do not appear in this field.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical street address of the registered office located in Vanuatu, maintained by the licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A physical registered office is mandatory; a post office box alone will not satisfy the Act.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name, license number, and attestation of the Vanuatu-licensed registered agent submitting the return.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Every IC must retain a licensed VFSC-approved agent; the agent certifies completion of AML customer due diligence on the non-resident beneficial owner.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4 — Register of Directors and Members
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, nationalities, residential addresses, and shareholdings of all directors, members, and beneficial owners.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors and shareholders are permitted; any previously issued bearer shares must be immobilized and surrendered; nominee holdings must be fully disclosed to the agent and beneficial ownership register.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 5 — Authorized and Issued Share Capital
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Reporting currency, authorized capital, issued shares, par value, and paid-up capital.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No minimum capital requirement applies; for the e-bike OEM structure, state the US dollar-denominated issuance and, if applicable, distinct Class A/B voting and dividend rights.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the IC has not carried on business in Vanuatu with local (non-IC) persons or derived income from Vanuatu domestic sources.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the e-bike enterprise invoices exclusively non-resident distributors and settles through TT wire/SWIFT letter of credit, elect 'No domestic business transacted' to preserve the non-resident tax-exempt character.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Self-certification of whether any ESR relevant activity was carried on during the reporting period and whether an ESR return must be appended.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Manufacture of electric cargo bicycles (ISIC 3091) is not a scheduled ESR relevant activity; select 'None — NIL ESR return' unless the entity also conducts intra-group financing, intellectual property holding, or commercial distribution functions.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: No CIT late-filing surcharge exists because no corporate income tax return is due. The operative penalty is the VFSC annual license regime: a 10% per month or part-month surcharge on the outstanding annual fee for late return/renewal, suspension of the certificate of good standing, administrative strike-off for persistent default, and restoration fees up to VUV 60,000 (c. USD 500). Knowingly false statements in the annual return attract a fine up to VUV 1,000,000 and imprisonment up to 10 years.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Vanuatu Economic Substance Return (ESR-1) under the Economic Substance Act 2022 and Economic Substance Regulations — filed with VFSC through the e-VFSC portal or the registered agent; no domestic tax figure is reported because the regime is a substance-declaration, not an income computation.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual — aligned to the entity's financial accounting reference date.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 12 months after the end of each financial year, or such shorter period as specified in the ESR Regulations for entities carrying on a relevant activity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Entity confirms whether it carried on any scheduled relevant activity: banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, financing and leasing, headquarters, holding company, intellectual property holding, or distribution and service centre.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For the electric cargo e-bike OEM scope, classify as 'None — Manufacturing is not a scheduled relevant activity'; record the NIL election to evidence compliance and rebut any shell characterization.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: States the financial year end and total gross revenue derived during that period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident OEM revenue invoiced in USD may be stated in VUV equivalent; if the entity conducts no relevant activity, this field is completed with a zero or 'NIL' marker.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: ESR-3 — Core Income Generating Activities (CIGA) in Vanuatu
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Narrative description of core income-generating activities conducted in Vanuatu, including local employees and physical premises.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If a relevant activity is inadvertently triggered (e.g., holding of e-bike patent IP or granting shareholder loans), provide detailed board minutes, local staffing FTE counts, and premises lease evidence; a NIL return requires no narrative.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating expenditure incurred inside Vanuatu versus outside, including payroll, rent, equipment, and outsourced function costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For the zero-substance OEM billing vehicle, VFSC expects this field to reconcile with bank statements and to show alignment with any minimal local payroll; unexplained external cost concentration flags conduit risk.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirms that meetings of directors occurred, that management decisions were made in Vanuatu, and that the signatory authority is documented.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors may participate by telephone/video conferencing, but the quorum, minutes, and decision logs must be physically retained with the Vanuatu registered agent.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: The Economic Substance Act 2022 authorizes VFSC to issue compliance notices, monetary penalty assessments, remedial directions, and strike-off orders for late or defective ESR returns; knowingly false ESR declarations expose the IC and its directors to criminal prosecution with fines up to VUV 1,000,000 per offense, imprisonment, and regulatory disqualification, in addition to correspondent-bank de-risking consequences.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no withholding tax on dividends paid or credited by an International Company to its non-resident shareholders.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double taxation agreement network and maintains no domestic TRC (tax residency certificate) mechanism; a non-resident recipient therefore cannot invoke a Vanuatu DTA because no Vanuatu source tax exists to relieve. The practical protocol for the foreign parent is documentary substantiation only: retain (i) the directors' resolution declaring the dividend, (ii) the TT wire or SWIFT LC flow evidence, and (iii) a VFSC certificate of good standing; these records are submitted to the shareholder's home tax authority to support any foreign tax credit analysis, which will normally conclude that no Vanuatu withholding tax is creditable because none was suffered.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding rate: 0% on interest and 0% on royalties paid by a Vanuatu IC to non-residents; no thin capitalization limitation and no domestic interest deductibility restriction apply in the zero-tax IC environment; treaty rates are moot because the statutory source-state rate is already zero.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No Vanuatu statute imposes Local File or Master File documentation; VFSC administers no transfer pricing adjustment regime and prescribes no VUV-denominated threshold. As a prudent governance benchmark for the e-bike OEM group, a notional documentation threshold of VUV 50,000,000 (c. USD 420,000) of annual cross-border intercompany sales is recommended to align with OECD TP documentation expectations of the buyer-side revenue authority.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu enacted the Economic Substance Act 2022, administered by VFSC, as a response to OECD and European Union good-governance standards. The test applies to International Companies carrying on a scheduled relevant activity, requiring the entity to be managed and directed in Vanuatu, to conduct core income-generating activity there, to maintain local premises, employees, and expenditure proportionate to income, and to file an annual ESR return. Manufacture of urban electric cargo bicycles under ISIC 3091 is not a listed relevant activity, so a pure OEM manufacturing entity is outside the ESR net; however, the IC should file the ESR NIL declaration and maintain real board minutes, physical registered office substance, and a proportionate local cost base at its Vanuatu registered agent to prevent recharacterization as a shell conduit by foreign tax authorities or financial institutions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion through Foreign-Source Opaque Structure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the VU IC as a nominal billing vehicle while actual e-bike manufacturing, contract negotiation, inventory risk, and day-to-day management reside in the controlling shareholder's taxable jurisdiction, thereby artificially extracting sales profit from the group's taxable base into Vanuatu's zero-tax regime.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Within Vanuatu, VFSC may suspend or strike off the IC and impose fines for false annual-return declarations. In the shareholder's home jurisdiction, the structure is vulnerable to sham/GAAR recharacterization, CFC attribution, reallocation of the full OEM profit margin, interest, penalties typically ranging from 20% to 200% of the understatement, and criminal tax-fraud prosecution where deliberate concealment is proven.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Signing false VFSC declarations exposes directors to fines up to VUV 1,000,000 and imprisonment up to 10 years under the International Companies Act; foreign courts may pierce the corporate veil to impose civil restitution of diverted profits, director disqualification, seizure of Vanuatu bank accounts, cross-border travel bans, and extradition-based imprisonment for tax fraud.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Failure of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Relying exclusively on the VU IC's tax-exempt status while performing no core income-generating activity in Vanuatu, retaining no local records, and submitting an ESR return falsely declaring 'none' despite conducting IP holding or intra-group financing connected to the e-bike operations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC may issue an ESR compliance notice, impose monetary penalty assessments, require a corrected return, and ultimately strike the company off the register; knowing inclusion of false information in an ESR filing is a criminal offense carrying fines up to VUV 1,000,000 per offense and custodial sanctions, with collateral effects including FATF/EU listing countermeasures, correspondent-bank account closure, and denial of banking services.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the registered agent acting with knowledge attract joint personal exposure: administrative penalties, disqualification orders, restoration cost recovery, and foreign judicial piercing of the veil reallocating manufacturing income to the true economic owner with civil restitution, asset freezes, travel bans, and imprisonment for fraudulent misrepresentation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to maintain a current beneficial ownership register, using undisclosed nominee shareholders, or processing Swift_LC and TT_Wire settlement payments for an undisclosed third-party principal while presenting the VU IC as the contracting entity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Breach of the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2022 and VFSC AML directives: monetary penalties, suspension or revocation of the registered agent's license, strike-off of the IC, freezing of the Vanuatu account, and disqualification of the compliance officer; where the underlying funds are criminal proceeds, the directors and any facilitating agent become subject to money-laundering prosecution with asset forfeiture.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face personal fines and confiscation orders; involvement in a laundering network triggers travel bans, mutual legal assistance arrests, and imprisonment in Vanuatu or the foreign prosecuting jurisdiction; the corporate veil is pierced as the IC is treated as a mere instrumentality of the undisclosed principal.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Structuring the VU IC to buy e-bikes or components at artificially low prices from a related manufacturer and resell at inflated prices to a related distributor, with no Vanuatu employees, premises, or commercial functions supporting the margins, solely to quarantine profit in a zero-tax jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu imposes no domestic transfer-pricing penalty because it has no TP statute; the sanction is imposed by trading-partner revenue authorities through transfer-pricing adjustments, controlled-foreign-company attribution, and general anti-abuse rules, producing additional tax, interest, and penalties of 20% to 40% of the recharacterized profit, plus in severe cases criminal tax-evasion charges; the bank executing the wire flows may also terminate the IC relationship for lack of economic purpose.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Officers who execute the artificial intercompany contracts and authorise the payment cascade may be held jointly and severally liable for restitution to the parent group; foreign GAAR and director-liability statutes permit personal penalty assessments, charging orders on personal assets, passport restrictions, and imprisonment for officers who knowingly certify false pricing documentation.
